column1: Sticky

1

Why an IDP, and why now? What specifically is broken today?

2

What is the cost of the status quo — what happens if nothing changes?

3

Who is the executive sponsor and what outcome are they accountable for?

4

Is this funded as a project with an end date, or as an ongoing product?

5

What are the expectations and success criteria for the engagement?

6

What are the outcomes and deliverables?

7

What does success look like at the end of the pilot, versus at scale?

8

What are the pilot exit criteria, and who signs them off?

9

Which teams are the pilot candidates, and why those?

10

Which parts of CLIENT are in scope, and which are explicitly out?

11

What is explicitly out of scope for this engagement?

12

Which decisions are already made and not open for discussion?

13

Is adoption mandated, incentivised, or opt-in?

14

What is the big picture — where does Developer Hub sit relative to Service Mesh, OpenShift and the existing toolchain?

15

Has a previous platform or portal attempt been made at CLIENT? What happened?

16

Is there an existing developer portal or IDP in place, even partially?

17

How can we make developers use the IDP over their existing flow? What is the driver?

18

What developer journeys are the highest priority for Dev Hub? (marked: to be completed offline)

A1

Is there an architecture decision record (ADR) process, and will RHDH design decisions be recorded in it?

A2

What is the target state at 12 and 24 months — how many services, teams and templates in the catalogue?

A3

Is there an existing platform-engineering strategy or enterprise architecture standard this design must conform to?

A4

Who holds design-authority sign-off, and which artefacts do they require — HLD, LLD, security pattern?

A5

What is the architecture review board cadence, and the lead time to secure approval?

A6

What is the appetite for customisation versus staying close to product defaults?

A7

Are there prior Backstage or portal proofs-of-concept whose learnings or assets apply?

A8

Is RHDH intended to be the single engineering entry point, or one portal among several?

A9

Which discovery items must be closed before detailed design can begin?

A10

What is the definition of done for the design phase, and who accepts it?
